description: Lock-down fixtures for the frozen version 1 evaluation arm. Each case supplies complete flag definitions and an evaluation context and records the hand-derived outcome.
definition_shape: definitions.flags uses the local evaluation feed shape: id, key, version, active, and filters with groups, multivariate, payloads, aggregation_group_type_index, holdout, and early_exit. Flag dependency filters carry the target flag key in key plus dependency_chain; server-side evaluators map the key to the fixture flag id.
context_shape: context carries distinct_id, person_properties, and optionally groups, group_properties. definitions.group_type_mapping maps group type index strings to group type names.

expectation_rules.value: Every conforming evaluator returns this value: boolean, or the assigned variant string.
expectation_rules.enabled_and_variant: The detailed projection fields: enabled is true for any truthy value and variant is the string value or null.
expectation_rules.payload: The stored payload under the key true or the assigned variant key, or null.
expectation_rules.reason: The authoritative evaluator's reason code and condition index. condition_index is the stored position of the condition that produced the reason, or null.
expectation_rules.local_evaluation: conclusive: a local evaluator must return value. inconclusive: a local evaluator must not return a value and must fall back to the authoritative evaluator. remote_only: the case pins authoritative behavior for a feature that local evaluators do not implement; a local evaluator that implements it must match.
expectation_rules.omitted_flags: Flags absent from every remote response version. A local evaluator reports them as false.
expectation_rules.hash_evidence: The hash01 values the outcome depends on, computed with sha1_60_v1 from the recorded input. Cases without evidence compute no hash.

cases.notes: The property filter matches and rollout_percentage 100 short-circuits, so no hash is computed. The payload stored under the key true is attached.
The only condition fails its property filter, so no rollout check runs.
An empty property list means the condition is a pure rollout check.
Without early_exit a rollout miss on condition 0 continues; condition 1 matches at 100 percent and reports its own index.
With early_exit true the rollout miss on condition 0 is terminal even though condition 1 would match.
Condition 0 misses rollout and condition 1 misses targeting. out_of_rollout_bound outranks no_condition_match, so the reported index stays 0.
Condition 0 misses targeting and condition 1 misses rollout. The higher-priority reason wins regardless of order, so the reported index is 1.
A null rollout_percentage behaves as 100 and computes no hash.
Condition 0 misses targeting. Condition 1 matches at 100 percent, so only the variant hash is computed. The payload stored under the variant key is attached.
No payload is stored under control, so payload is null.
Condition 0 matches targeting and carries a valid variant override, so the override replaces the hashed assignment.
The override wide is not a declared variant key, so the hashed assignment is used while the matching condition index is still reported.
Rollout and variant assignment use two independent hashes that differ only by the salt.
A rollout miss on a multivariate flag returns false and computes no variant hash.
A group flag hashes the group key, never the distinct_id.
The JSON number 42 normalizes to the decimal string 42 before hashing.
The context has no organization key, so the group condition is skipped and no hash is computed.
The dependency filter names the target flag key and expects boolean true, which matches any enabled result.
A dependency that evaluates to false fails the dependent condition as a targeting miss, not a rollout miss.
A string expected value matches only the exact assigned variant key.
The target key is not in the definitions and the dependency chain is empty. The authoritative evaluator fails the flag closed; a local evaluator must report the flag as inconclusive and fall back.
Holdout membership is checked before any condition. The synthesized variant is holdout- followed by the holdout id, no condition index is reported, and no condition or variant hash is computed.
Outside the holdout the ordinary conditions run and the variant hash assigns test.
An inactive flag is omitted from every remote response version. A local evaluator reports it as false.
